method: Read pinned upstream implementation, its public issue #814 and linked PR #839, and compared with Connect source. No upstream builds, tests, imported production code or A/V reruns.

findings.observed: Re-election retains the original active connection while candidates are evaluated. Successful election selects the new owner and subsequently drops the original.
findings.connect_application: Audit preparation, readiness, commit and old-owner retirement as separate boundaries. Preserve old-owner service on precommit failure; prepare candidates without granting ordinary media authority.
findings.limit: Server-connection election is not proof of cross-device or cross-adapter replacement with Connect durable operations/current authority. Inspect actual Connect boundaries before changing them.
non_av_checks: Candidate preparation failure preserves original owner and terminal status.
Cancellation or revocation before commit cannot activate candidate.
Duplicate completion and late original cleanup cannot retire replacement.

findings.observed: Sequence-indexed bounded buffer, keyframe-first decoding, gap recovery at later keyframes, adaptive delay and restart heuristics.
findings.connect_application: Use their test scenarios as a comparison for reordering and new-decoder startup; keep Connect authenticated generation boundary rather than treating sequence rollback as sufficient authority.
findings.limit: Their maximum video delay is 500ms and buffer capacity is 200 frames; these are not Connect acceptance limits. File inspection is not a benchmark or proof of end-to-end A/V synchronization. A/V work remains deferred.

findings.observed: The project reported independent per-packet QUIC streams producing reordering interpreted as loss and excessive keyframe requests. Issue is closed and links #839.
findings.connect_comparison: Connect BrowserMediaPeer owns WebTransport datagram streams (browser_media.ts), not the exact per-packet reliable-stream path described in #814. The general ordering/feedback lesson applies; the issue is not evidence of the same bug in Connect.

findings.observed: NetEq audio work runs in a Worker and PCM is delivered through an AudioWorklet; readiness and worker lifecycle are explicit.
findings.connect_application: Compare worker initialization, clock labeling and teardown when audio investigation resumes.
findings.limit: Do not infer proven inter-media synchronization from an audio jitter buffer. Do not use concealment, adaptive buffering or larger delay as evidence that original samples met Connect criteria.

next_work: Continue all non-AV G6-058 matrix requirements; use replacement lifecycle lessons for control verification. A/V sync remains deferred.
